input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Explore: copy drift across vendored helpers

doc_friction.issue: The 'reads that throw' case existed for two counter designs but not the usageAllowed/recordEvent one, so 36 copies passed check_storage_guard while recordEvent threw; a fix in #14699 reached only 3 copies and the contract was not extended then.
--for-changes on a 36-venture diff ran over 10 minutes (portfolio-validate, site tests) and detached; fine, but the PR had to wait on it.

deviations.why: Built a report tool (copy_drift.mjs) rather than a CI gate: most drift is deliberate, so a gate would be noise.
deviations.did: Report plus a targeted contract case for the one real bug it found.
deviations.result: Contract now catches the bug class (72 breaches on old tree, 0 on fixed).

notes: Idea: copy drift. Group 45,665 named JS functions across ventures by name; list minority bodies a few tokens from the majority body (token Levenshtein, quote style normalised). First run: 615 candidates; ~40 read. Real bug: usageAllowed() unguarded getItem in 36 of 39 ventures (3 fixed in #14699); with a throwing getItem, recordEvent() threw inside the render try, hiding the price. Verified in Chromium on locksmith-bid-calculator: before 'The operation is insecure.' + price hidden; after $214.43. 36 venture suites pass (run_venture_tests.py). test_copy_drift.mjs 4/4. check_storage_guard.py: 0 breaches (72 with ventures stashed). run_workflow_locally --for-changes: pages 6/6, ventures-tests 5/5, portfolio-validate 100/100, control-plane-guard, conflict-markers, doc-refs passed (uses: steps not run); portfolio-pages 12/12; 7/7 selected workflows passed locally (uses: steps, cross-review and deploy jobs not run). Graduation: a run could triage the report top-down for small real fixes.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: Writing a token-diff clone report, triaging ~40 findings, patching 36 files with a browser check

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
